mentions.name: Tiled Words
mentions.description: A daily word puzzle game with a new puzzle every day, streak tracking (over 100 players have 100+ day streaks), and a recently released custom player puzzles feature where the community submits puzzles for the creator to review and solve. Currently free, with monetized subscription features being considered to fund more puzzle creation. Recent work includes a fix for crashes on older iPhones by switching positioning rules from CSS transforms to SVG coordinates.
